title: The Journey to Destiny
content:
Sneha stood frozen for a few moments, unable to believe everything that had happened within a single day.

A promotion...

A chance to work in France...

And a message from Siddu himself.

Her heart felt lighter than it had in years.

Still holding her phone tightly, she hurried out of her boss's cabin.

The moment she spotted Yagnesh waiting outside, she ran toward him.

"Yagnesh!"

He looked at her in surprise.

"What happened?"

Without saying a word, Sneha handed him her phone.

He read the message.

"How is my birthday gift?"

A smile slowly spread across his face.

"So..."

"He finally remembered."

Sneha nodded excitedly.

"I can't believe it."

"He remembered my birthday..."

"And because of this promotion..."

"I'm finally going to meet him."

Before Yagnesh could reply, Sneha's boss walked out of his cabin.

He smiled proudly.

"Congratulations once again, Sneha."

"Next week, you and your team will be leaving for France."

"I hope you'll make us proud."

Sneha smiled respectfully.

"Thank you very much, sir."

"I won't disappoint you."

________________________________________

That evening...

Sneha and Yagnesh returned home.

The moment Sneha stepped inside, her mother looked at her curiously.

"How was the meeting?"

Sneha couldn't hold back her excitement any longer.

"Mom..."

"I got promoted."

"And..."

"I'm being transferred to France for an official project."

Her mother's eyes widened with happiness.

"Really?"

Sneha nodded enthusiastically.

"Yes!"

Her mother immediately hugged her.

"I'm so proud of you."

"Congratulations, my dear!"

Sneha hugged her back tightly.

For the first time in years...

The dream she had silently protected inside her heart finally felt within reach.

She was going to meet Siddu again.

________________________________________

Later that night...

Unable to control her excitement, Sneha picked up her phone.

She stared at Siddu's contact for several seconds before finally pressing the call button.

The phone rang...

Once...

Twice...

Three times...

But no one answered.

The call disconnected.

A small disappointment crossed her face.

For a moment, she lowered her head.

Then she smiled to herself.

"Calm down, Sneha."

"You've already waited five years."

"You can wait one more week."

"This time..."

"I'll meet him in person."

Holding onto that thought...

She quietly placed her phone aside.

________________________________________

The following week passed faster than she had imagined.

Her days became a whirlwind of office work, project handovers, shopping, packing, and preparing documents for the international assignment.

Yet...

No matter how busy she became...

Her thoughts always ended with one person.

Siddu.

Every night before sleeping, she wondered what their first meeting after five years would be like.

Would he smile?

Would he be surprised?

Or would he simply stand there...

Speechless...

Just like she imagined countless times.

________________________________________

A few days later...

While arranging her luggage, Sneha suddenly remembered Shreya's words.

"Don't worry..."

"I'll help your love story reach its happy ending."

A warm smile appeared on her face.

Without wasting another moment, she called Shreya.

The call connected after a few rings.

"Hello, Sneha."

"Shreya!"

"I have good news!"

"What happened?"

"I got promoted."

"And..."

"I'm coming to France next week."

For a brief second, there was complete silence.

Then Shreya laughed happily.

"So..."

"He finally understood your love."

"Congratulations, Sneha."

Sneha smiled shyly.

"Maybe..."

"I don't know."

"But I hope so."

Shreya couldn't resist teasing her.

"I think someone is already counting the hours until she sees Siddu."

Sneha covered her face, laughing.

"Please don't tease me."

The two of them laughed together, talking for several more minutes before ending the call.

________________________________________

Finally...

The day arrived.

Early in the morning, Sneha reached the airport along with Yagnesh and two other teammates from her company.

Her parents had come to see her off.

Her mother adjusted the collar of her jacket one last time.

"Take care of yourself."

"And don't forget to eat on time."

Sneha smiled.

"I won't, Mom."

Sneha hugged her tightly.

Then, picking up her luggage, she slowly turned toward the departure gate.

As she walked forward...

She looked back one last time and waved.

A new journey had begun.

One that wasn't just taking her to another country...

It wasn't just a flight to France.

It was a journey toward the love she had protected for five long years.

Destiny had separated them once...

Now...

It was finally bringing them back together.
